description:
Research and record rare-earth-free QDD robotic actuators and a path to manufacturing our own actuators. Jake states robotics will probably use quasi-direct-drive; long-term own actuators should drastically reduce cost while maintaining useful performance and avoid rare-earth magnets. Research scope, not authorization to purchase hardware or redesign current grippers. Preserve existing motor interfaces/prototypes.

Initial research 2026-10-23: prioritize ferrite flux-concentrating spoke/IPM or ferrite-assisted synchronous reluctance versus ferrite Halbach and magnet-free synchronous/switched reluctance. Rank on robotic continuous/stall torque at thermal equilibrium, peak duration, joint speed, mass/envelope, backdrivability, torque ripple, low-speed control, demagnetization over temperature, manufacturing cost and complete actuator BOM. Do not substitute high-rpm EV peak kW for joint torque or assume magnet cost dominates small-batch actuators. Torque=power/angular speed; gearing trades speed and reflected inertia. Benchmark existing RS00/RS06 joint requirements, label any target assumptions.

Primary leads: ORNL ferrite prototype demonstrated 103kW peak (traction, not robot proof): https://www.ornl.gov/news/motors-powering ; technical report https://info.ornl.gov/sites/publications/files/Pub59624.pdf discusses lower ferrite remanence/coercivity and flux concentration. Ferrite-assisted SynRM simulation with Elmer, manufactured/tested prototype: https://dgjsxb.ces-transaction.com/EN/abstract/abstract7518.shtml . SyR-e open-source Apache2 MATLAB electrical-machine design/eDrive simulation: https://github.com/SyR-e/syre_public (MATLAB dependency, not fully free toolchain; motor models are not ready robot hardware). ODRI BSD3 actuator mechanical/electronic designs: https://github.com/open-dynamic-robot-initiative/open_robot_actuator_hardware ; moteus Apache2 controller PCB/firmware: https://github.com/mjbots/moteus . These are reusable mechanical/control foundations, NOT verified rare-earth-free motors nor drop-in controllers for all reluctance topologies. Additional unverified magnet-material lead: https://github.com/CKraft11/Ironless-QDD-Actuator ; ironless does not mean magnet-free/rare-earth-free.

Material trap: high-performance ferrite can contain rare-earth lanthanum. Require supplier composition/demagnetization curves for explicitly La-free strontium ferrite, and audit encoder/brake magnets too if whole actuator must be RE-free. TDK primary guide confirms La-Co-added and La-Co-free classes: https://product.tdk.com/de/system/files?file=dam/doc/product/magnet/magnet/ferrite/datasheets/magnet_fb_summary_en.pdf . Cobalt is not itself a rare earth, but cost/supply concern. Heavy-rare-earth-free NdFeB does not meet no-rare-earth goal.

Cybercab ferrite Halbach claim not verified from primary disclosure in initial search; media describe speculation. Do not present it as confirmed Tesla architecture or open-source design. Halbach is one flux arrangement to evaluate, not guaranteed recovery of NdFeB torque density. No complete proven open-source rare-earth-free QDD actuator identified in initial search; do not claim none exists. Verify licenses and manufacturing-ready files versus papers/tooling separately.

Deliver sourced project research/decision record with shortlist, evidence confidence and measured-vs-simulated status; realistic prototype roadmap and parameterized cost comparison at low vs volume production without fabricated supplier prices. Propose simulation of equal envelope/current/cooling/gear-ratio candidates then a dynamometer prototype measuring continuous torque, efficiency, temperature, ripple and backdrive torque. Research only at this stage; retain QDD preference in shared project docs through normal pebble flow.

results.identified_issue: Research-only request. Verified primary sources and July 2026 RobStride CAN2.0 manuals, separating manufacturer ratings, measured traction/prototype evidence, proposed targets and unperformed robot tests. Corrected shared self-building plan claims that QDD requires magnets and that a Tesla announcement establishes ferrite adoption; prioritized explicitly La-free ferrite spoke/IPM and ferrite-assisted SynRM with magnet-free SynRM comparator. CKraft author specifies N50/N52, so ironless design fails rare-earth criterion; README MIT declaration is incomplete versus a full standalone license notice. Cost comparison is parametric with unknown quote/yield inputs, not claimed savings. No purchase, CAD, motor interface or version change; no simulations/hardware tests performed. Checked local links, whitespace and torque/speed arithmetic. Generated/GitInfo.swift was already modified and excluded.
results.summary: Recorded the rare-earth-free QDD shortlist and a staged path to manufacturing our own actuators.
results.detailed_description:
The research favors La-free ferrite spoke/IPM and ferrite-assisted reluctance for the first comparison, alongside magnet-free synchronous reluctance. I corrected the shared plan’s magnet and Halbach assumptions and kept QDD as your preferred architecture.

The linked record includes RS00/RS06 benchmarks, source confidence, reusable designs and licenses, a simulation-to-dynamometer roadmap, and a complete-actuator cost model at prototype and production volumes. Savings and robot-joint performance remain unproven; review this before commissioning simulation or hardware.

results.notes: Jake requests RobStride verification and bulk purchasing research. Official Seeed BOM confirms our documented purchased B601-RS uses3 RS06 and4 RS00 including gripper: https://github.com/Seeed-Projects/reBot-DevArm/blob/main/hardware/reBot_B601_RS/README.md . Record RobStride as current leading candidate for our project, tentative rather than proven market leader or rare-earth-free. Verified2026-10-23 Seeed USD pricing: RS00 single138.99,10+131.99 each https://www.seeedstudio.com/Robostride-00-Actuator-p-6664.html ; RS06 single210,10+200 each https://www.seeedstudio.com/Robostride-06-Actuator-p-6668.html . Both listed in stock. Tier thresholds per SKU; mixed-cart not verified. Seven-motor equivalent1185.96 singles or1127.96 at both volume tiers, excluding shipping/taxes/duties. Four arm sets(16 RS00,12 RS06) meet both tiers. Direct manufacturer quote channel https://robstride.com/about-us lists zhaoyuan@robstride.com and mass production/customization, but no confirmed MOQ/discount. Seeed contact https://www.seeedstudio.com/contacts . Suggested RFQ10/50/100 per model covering revisions,CAN compatibility,leadtime,warranty/spares,landed cost,magnet composition. No contact or purchase performed/authorized. Preserve long-term rare-earth-free research. /Users/jakeschantz/HelpingHands
